entries.surface: browser REST handwritten transport mirrors and generic request<T> trust
entries.decision: OpenAPI 3.1 becomes the public HTTP authority; generated boundary types replace byte-for-byte handwritten transport mirrors while domain/view models remain handwritten.
JSON Schema 2020-12 becomes the single public stream authority and generates the TS union/runtime validator.

entries.surface: Python internal runtime events represented by the generic StreamEvent envelope
entries.decision: Introduce a dedicated Proto/Buf InternalRuntimeEvent contract; public StreamEvent and internal Agent protocol become distinct types.
Use typed internal variants so impossible event states cannot be represented as one dataclass with unrelated optional fields.

entries.surface: malformed model tool-call JSON normalized to empty arguments
entries.decision: Malformed tool arguments remain an explicit invalid/protocol-error state and are never executed as an empty valid call.
Validation/building uses value semantics; normalization returns a new value explicitly.

entries.surface: raw string Job status including duplicate completed/succeeded terminal semantics
entries.decision: Use typed JobStatus and retain one canonical successful terminal state: completed.

entries.surface: Job read-check-write transition and best-effort authoritative lifecycle append
entries.decision: Repository transition becomes compare-and-set and the authoritative lifecycle event commits in the same transaction.
One phase vocabulary remains; successful readiness is represented only by ready_for_analysis.
Only the current evidence-grounded Assessment contract serves runtime/API/Web; old report shapes may survive solely in eval/archive fixtures.

entries.surface: authentication fallback for legacy tokens without session_id
entries.decision: All vNext authenticated sessions require the canonical session-aware token contract.
Opaque storage identity is the only runtime storage authority; host/local file-path compatibility is not public contract state.
With no business data migration requirement, new durable BodyState facts require canonical body_region_id rather than preserving ambiguous historical rows.
BodyState/Lifestyle/current domain structures are authoritative; health_features does not appear in the vNext baseline schema.

entries.surface: historical Assessment/Diagnosis/Treatment/Posture manifests selectable from serving governance
entries.decision: Historical configs may remain as offline replay/eval evidence but cannot be current serving, canary, promotion or rollback targets in vNext runtime policy.
These are the current canonical role manifests at the baseline; vNext may simplify selection policy without changing qualified role semantics.

Do not promote an unqualified OCR mechanism merely to remove a legacy label. Keep the currently qualified mechanism until separate benchmark evidence accepts a successor; remove only unnecessary compatibility wrappers/projections.
Git history preserves the old lineage; the active vNext migration directory starts from a clean PostgreSQL 18 + pgvector baseline.

entries.surface: source-derived/manual API inventory as future Postman authority
entries.decision: Postman and API exploration artifacts derive from canonical OpenAPI instead of becoming an independently maintained contract.

entries.surface: tests bypassing production contracts with casts or source-string assertions
entries.decision: Prefer behavior/runtime/type/architecture tests; source-string assertions remain only where no stronger executable invariant is available.
